g.text: Student head, live (mean of 3 benchmarks, 1,045 tasks)
Hollow = teacher, solid = student head; circle = train states, square = held-out test states; live shaded. Offline: first five SFT proposals per state, scored on held-out rollouts 4–8;
Oracle = best action on rollouts 1–3; student head = seed 0, the one run live. Bars: paired 95% intervals (bootstrap over tasks). Each point is relative to one SFT sample on its own states or tasks
